subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: We live in environment (a) ______ includes air, water, soil and sound. As a good environment is good for good inhabitants, (b) ______ a polluted environment is harmful to inhabitants. (c) ______ people show indifference to keep the environment clean. In some areas they (d) ______ do not like pollution. We should take steps to prevent environmental pollution. (e) ______ we should be aware of environment pollution.
guide_solution: Connectors: (a) that (b) but (c) As/Since (d) Though (e) So
